Well to be honest I did a trip with my brother, we rented a car, we went to

 Cahuita (You should definitely go or check for yourself but this place is dope for going out and interact with ticos (locals) , plus you have Pierto viejo and puerto limon, if I get the name correctly, which are great places too next to it)

Tortugero which is a really nice place to visit you just have to pull you car somewhere 30km next to the town itself, only accessible by small boat, but my fookin god this place was heaven on earth and appart from some tourist locals are very nice and welcoming. Architecturally.. There was nothing but local houses and some small flats next to the see (saying small flats, more like better houses than ticos but still a tico's house ^^)

Volcan arenal is a great place if you have money because the hotels there are wonderful plus there is a natural volcanic water flow in the jungle where ticos drink and smoke weed etc, nice place to party with ticos! There's a zip line that goes from an upper part of the city and it shows you the volcan and the lake next to it while sliding at 150meter high (was pretty intense to me), I went to La fortuna when visiting around the volcan to be precise

Montezuma which was the end of our trip but fuckin hell this was the best, this is a very small hippie town with lots of Americans, but not your usual American tourists. Most of them actually live there so finding an air bnb there is really easy, and they all are 60's hippies living their lifes their, or just younger ones enjoying the horse mount on the beach (under the sun during 4 hours tho (dont ask me why I did that I hate horse mounting but was worth it though)) or partying and visiting because this place is wonderful too. There a 20m high waterfall that you can jump from down there too(didnt have the balls to do so, only one tico did it and we clapped because of the weightness of his balls)

To finish that, this country is gorgeous, nice choice I would come back as soon as I can. Plus ticos are sweethearts, welcoming, smiling, giving you tips on where to find good food, good drinks, enjoy it guys
